BrochureContent.Content:
Fancy waking up everyday, at home, feeling like you`re on holidays? Both beach and village combine here in this convenient location, close to train station and motorway. This property comprises a lovely 3 bedroom house situated in the attractive seaside village of Laytown being of likely interest to first time buyers; as well as those `right-sizing` perhaps up from an apartment or maybe into the village from a detached country home; and indeed, to savvy investors requiring a property in a proven convenient and central location, ideal for rental.

Quillsen is delighted to welcome you to Number 13 South Shore Drive, this 3-bedroom home located a few minutes` walk to Laytown train station (Dublin/Belfast line). Owner-occupied, this property has had a new oil boiler recently installed.

This property has all the ingredients for the discerning first time buyer seeking a residential property in the much sought after coastal area of Laytown.

Early viewing is a must be advised that this property is likely to be snapped up given its many positive attributes including keen pricing, impressive location and good layout.

FEATURES
Large versatile living room
3 bedrooms, master ensuite
Easily maintained gardens to the front and rear
Oil fired central heating
Off street parking
Only a short stroll to sandy beach
Easy walk to village amenities and train station (Dublin/Belfast line)
Convenient to M1 motorway and Drogheda
Owner occupied, ideal investment

LOCATION
Local transport to both Drogheda Town Centre and Dublin City Centre can be found close to the entrance to this residential development, while Laytown Train Station is within a 3 minute walk or so. Commuters will find the location super convenient, with the M1 motorway a 10 minute drive or so.

South Shore Drive is located convenient, some 200 metres or so, to the beach of the pretty seaside village of Laytown in County Meath and a few minutes drive to Sonairte, the National Ecology Centre, where you can tour the bee museum, experience the nature trail and wander through the gorgeous organic garden. Shop local produce and sustainable products at the Sonairte Food and Craft Market and after, stroll along the beautiful sandy beach and admire the expansive coastline.

The village of Laytown, with its stunning shoreline with famous white sandy beach, is a well-connected and thriving commuter location offering a host of amenities. The natural splendour of the area, not just the beach, but the many local walking trails and forested areas, are real draws. The village offers several hostelry outlets including cafes and bars, as well as convenient stores and in recent years, has had an Aldi outlet developed here. It is home to Scoil An Spioraid Naoimh senior primary school.

Laytown is approximately twenty minutes` walk from the village of Bettystown. Bettystown has a variety of independent shops newsagents, butchers and florists and a Tesco Superstore. Scoil Oilibhéir Naofa junior primary school is located in Bettystown too.

Nearby, Southgate Shopping Centre is anchored by Dunnes Stores and Drogheda is home to Scotch Hall Shopping Centre, with a wide range of outlets to provide much retail therapy. The area is well served with many facilities for pre-school, primary and post-primary schools. Golf, soccer, rugby, football, hurling, tennis, surfing, fishing, hunting and equestrian including horse racing amongst other sports are all provided for in the area.

VIEWING
In order to fully appreciate this property, viewing is highly recommended, but strictly by appointment with the selling agents.
